geom_reference_point: D_axis_mid (cylinder axis mid-point per coordinate_frame_definition_v0 SSOT; +Z_D = nominal tumble/symmetry axis)

tumble_axis.label: +Z_D
tumble_axis.rate_context: magnitude order only from MMT/RoBo6/LCDC upper-stage light-curve datasets (~few deg/s up to tens of deg/s); used ONLY for Stage-2 angular-rate initial condition, NOT for geometry
tumble_axis.note: real spent stages precess/nutate and can flat-spin; Z_D is the nominal principal/spin axis, not a guaranteed pure single-axis rotation

features.grasp_region: rim / ring: the two proud end rings (forward_end_ring_grasp at +Z, aft_end_ring_flange at -Z) are the stiffest capture features; a mid-body reinforced band at the rib ring is a secondary option. Smooth shell wall is NOT a grasp surface.

marker_points_mm.surface: forward end-cap flat, inside forward ring rim

keepout.reason: thin unreinforced shell, crush/puncture risk - forbidden grasp/contact
fragile engine bell, assumed possible residual propellant - forbidden contact

collision_envelope.note: cylinder axis (Z_D) must be renderable in sim per Target-2 requirement

features.mount_face_M: N/A - non-cooperative debris has no defined mechanical mounting/servicing interface (frame M applies only to servicer arm-mount adapter, not to a target)

assumptions: No manufacturing/measured CAD of a cylindrical upper-stage/adapter debris exists in the asset pool (gap RA-003); this is an ORIGINAL simplified block model, not copied from any open asset. Tsinghua space_robot debris URDF is license-gate D and explicitly NOT used.

Representative envelope chosen: body Ø1200 mm x 2000 mm long = a 'small spent upper-stage / large payload-adapter shell segment' scale, not tied to any specific vehicle (Agena-class ~1.5 m dia noted only as an upper bound reference).

True structure is a thin-walled hollow shell; here it is modeled as solid boxes+cylinders. Inertia is SELF-DEFINED via effective density (builder sizes density to hit target_mass_kg), never claimed as measured (RA-003 / R-014).

target_mass_kg = 150 kg is a STATED ASSUMPTION for a depleted/empty thin-wall aluminum shell of this envelope (lateral+cap area ~9.8 m^2 x ~3 mm Al ~= 80 kg shell + rings/nozzle/residual ~= 150 kg); confidence LOW.
+Z_D = nominal tumble/symmetry axis per SSOT; real debris precesses/nutates and may flat-spin - Z_D is the nominal spin/principal axis only.
Tumble-rate magnitude taken as ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE context from MMT/RoBo6/LCDC light-curve data for Stage-2 angular-rate IC; it informs dynamics, NOT geometry.
Non-cooperative target: no standard servicing/mount interface, so mount_face_M (frame M) is N/A; grasp is on native structure (end rings / reinforced band), never on a defined docking port.
Grasp region = the two proud end rings (rim/ring), the stiffest features; smooth thin cylindrical shell wall is keepout (crush risk).
Aft nozzle stub added to represent a spent engine bell (simplified as a plain cylinder); aft region flagged keepout as fragile / possible residual propellant.

AprilTag/marker features are NOT debris-native - the +X_D shell bracket plate and the flat forward end-cap are provided as CANDIDATE marker locations for the servicer scenario; real debris carries no cooperative marker.
Reinforcement rib ring at z=+300 is a nominal stiffener placeholder (jiagou jin / flange); its exact location is assumed.

D origin placed at the body-cylinder axis mid-point per SSOT; geometric center assumed ~= CoM for the symmetric shell. The nozzle biases CoM slightly toward -Z; this small offset is ignored at v0 (record separately when inertia is estimated).
+X_D chosen as the nominal servicer approach / marker-visible direction (analogous to the +X_T convention in target_models_requirements).
All dimensions in millimeters; primitives are boxes + cylinders only, unioned; no fillets, holes, wall thickness, or manufacturing detail.
open_asset_refs: 42 (NASA GSFC) - tumbling rigid-body + contact dynamics reuse, custom inertia/omega
MMT/RoBo6/LCDC (kyselica/RoBo6) - upper-stage real tumble-rate calibration CONTEXT ONLY, no geometry
NASA SmallSat SOA - active debris removal narrative (Target-2 reference)
NASA-3D Agena - cylindrical upper-stage geometry-level reference only (per-model check, not copied)
note: inertia about CoM in frame D; tensor convention (URDF/Basilisk)
